0022600173.text: The 76ers (6-1, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, on a three-game winning streak) head to Detroit (5-1, first in the Central, on a two-game winning streak) with Philadelphia 3-0 on the road this season. The 2026-27 season series is tied... no, Philadelphia trails 0-1 after a 106-93 loss in Philadelphia on October 25, and the 76ers were swept 0-4 by the Pistons in the 2025-26 season. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), while Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip, bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring, strain).
